timeline.subtitle: A System 1 proposal for Naughty-or-Nice at scale
timeline.narration: Dear Santa. Your judgement system is ancient. Let's upgrade it.

timeline.heading: The December Problem
timeline.narration: Two billion children. One night. Every single one needs a verdict. Even your gut, Santa, is tired.

timeline.heading: Enter System 1
timeline.narration: System 1, from Kahneman: fast, intuitive, pattern-matching. Like your elves, but instant. Think snap judgement, not Skynet.

image.prompt: minimal isometric illustration of a cozy santa workshop with a glowing neural network diagram floating above the workbench, candy cane and warm firelight palette, deep blue background, clean flat vector style

timeline.heading: Judgements per minute
timeline.narration: Right now you manage three per minute. The elves hit forty. A trained System 1 model? Five thousand. Easily.

timeline.heading: Pop culture approved
items: The Good Place — but with ops
timeline.narration: It is Moneyball for mischief. Minority Report, but cookie-coded. The Good Place scoring system, finally with operations.

timeline.heading: Projected deliveries per hour
timeline.narration: Deploy this year, and deliveries per hour jump one hundred and forty percent. Mrs. Claus will be thrilled.
Ho ho ho, Santa. Ship it.
